      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows', modifies CMake build configuration and GitHub CI workflows to switch native Windows compilation to clang-cl.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Switching native Windows builds and CI from MSVC to clang-cl resolves recurring compiler bugs and ICE workarounds (#31456, #36153) while significantly boosting performance. CI build times drop from 20m 35s to 12m 43s, block connection benchmarks show 55–60% speedups, and hardware-accelerated inline assembly on Windows is unblocked."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates to build-windows-native.md and release notes follow directly from the build toolchain migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not documentation: documentation changes are secondary updates documenting the compiler requirement change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The change to src/kernel/CMakeLists.txt is a mechanical CMake flag adjustment following from the compiler switch.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not kernel: does not affect the kernel API, boundary, or encapsulation."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Candidate matched on unrelated path heuristic; does not touch peer-to-peer networking code.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not P2P: does not touch peer-to-peer networking or protocols."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

    },

      "name": "utils",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not utils: compatibility header adjustments directly serve the build toolchain migration rather than providing shared utility improvements."
    }
